title: Product Option
description: A product option such as size, color, or material.

name.description: Option name as displayed to the buyer, in the response language (e.g., 'Size', 'Color', 'Colour').

key.description: Stable, language-independent identifier for what this option varies, so Platforms can recognize the same option across Businesses and languages. Well-known values: `color`, `size`, `gender`, `age_group`, `material`, `pattern`. Platforms MUST tolerate unknown values. Unique within a product's `options`.
